Simon (Support): P1 -> MiraHealth onboarding blocked, activation flow failing at token exchange. Customer on trial, seat enablement stuck, renewal at risk if not resolved in 24h :fire:
Carla (CS): @Simon can you paste the error and last successful step? we should start comms to account and schedule call asap :phone:
Simon (Support): error from auth service: `ERROR 403: invalid_grant - token already used`
Simon (Support): Steps tried: rotated integration key (no change), re-sent invite, cleared cache. Last successful step was user invite email delivered but activation link returns the 403
Jin (CSM): tagging me. I can join customer call. Need proposed owner and ETA for fix. Customer segment = mid-market, trial expires in 5 days
Priya (Solutions Eng): quick ask — can we try issuing a fresh single-use activation token from admin panel? If that fails, we should enable a manual provisioning bypass for this customer only
Ajay (Eng Oncall): looking. please attach logs (request ids) and correlation id from the failed exchange. I can check token service and downstream KMS interactions
Simon (Support): attaching logs (excerpt): `req=0x9b3f token_exchange failed grant_id=abcd1234 status=403 svc=auth`
Simon (Support): correlation id: `cor-1795-mh-88`
Carla (CS): comms plan suggestion: 1) immediate customer note acknowledging escalation + ETA 2) scheduled 1-hr troubleshooting call within 4 hours 3) provide temporary workaround (manual provisioning) if eng confirms safe 4) follow-up with RCA and next steps within 48h
Jin (CSM): I’ll draft the customer note. @Priya can you confirm whether manual provision requires code deploy or just DB flag flip?
Priya (Solutions Eng): manual provision is a DB flag + issuing a one-time token. No deploy if Ajay confirms no KMS rotation required.
Ajay (Eng Oncall): quick check — KMS OK. Looks like token service rejected reuse checks. I can issue admin token for MiraHealth and watch exchange. Doing now, will report back in ~20m
deploy-bot: Deployment to `auth-sidecar` started by Ajay (eng-oncall) — sha: a1b2c3 — rolling canary
Ajay (Eng Oncall): auth-sidecar canary done, issued admin token for customer `mira-health-acc-77`. Token exchange attempted and succeeded for test account. Simon, can you try activation for the real user now?
Simon (Support): trying now… activation succeeded for one user. pushing full invite again to customer.
Carla (CS): Great. Plan: 1) Confirm full customer activation within 2h 2) Host troubleshooting call at 30m from now to walk through steps and capture feedback 3) Offer 1-week trial extension because of friction (pre-approve?)
Jin (CSM): I’ll offer the trial extension and follow up on renewal risk language. @Carla please send the customer-facing note; I’ll join the call
Priya (Solutions Eng): Recommend follow-up: add a quick E2E test for activation in staging and add a short alert if `invalid_grant` spikes >3 in 1h for onboarding namespace
Ajay (Eng Oncall): filing incident ticket and RCA task — will update here with link: https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-1795-mira (placeholder)
Carla (CS): customer note drafted: "Thanks for flagging — we escalated and have a temporary fix. We're scheduling a troubleshooting call in 30 minutes and will extend your trial by 7 days while we finish the investigation." Posting to customer in 10m unless objections
Simon (Support): no objections. Please include instructions for any steps customer should avoid (re-clicking old activation links)
Jin (CSM): On call — confirm we capture screen recording and permission to record session for debugging notes
Carla (CS): confirmed. Postmortem owners: Ajay (eng), Priya (se), Jin (cs). Communication owner: Carla.
Simon (Support): closing handback: status -> P1 escalated to CS, mitigation applied (manual admin token), customer scheduled call, trial extension pending, incident ticket created.
Carla (CS): thanks team. after call, please drop a short summary here for the renewal risk queue so AMs can update their forecasts :thumbsup:
Jin (CSM): noted — will update renewal risk board after call
Ajay (Eng Oncall): will post RCA link and timeframe once analysis complete
Carla (CS): Marking this as `priority: urgent-handback` in our internal tracker. Good work everyone :tada:
Simon (Support): Thanks all — handing over to CS for ongoing comms and renewal follow-up
Carla (CS): thread moved to CS triage board and archived in support-handoffs folder
